review_candidates.description: You’ve picked a great time to join Avon. We’re the company that puts purpose, people and relationships at the heart of everything we do. The company that’s 135 years young and only just getting started. As part of the Regent LP family, we’re committed to being the best beauty company for the world by generating a positive environmental, economic and social impact for our communities across the globe. Role Type Permanent What You'll Be Doing As a Senior Network Engineer you will play critical role in designing, managing, and improving Avon’s network infrastructure that powers our global operations across manufacturing, retail, and direct selling. You’ll participate in designing technical solutions and will be responsible to provision and manage these environments the most effective, secure, and resilient way. Identifying and documenting best practices, troubleshooting issues, plus providing technical directions to the Network and Network Security teams are also key part of the role. Key Responsibilities Provide L3 support for network transport, routing, DNS, load balancing, and network automation Lead and mentor L2 analysts, maintain documentation, and ensure compliance with security and audit standards Optimizing, monitoring and supporting network transport, routing, DNS, DHCP, and load balancing Leading and participating in troubleshooting connectivity, routing, segmentation, and application delivery issues Performing routine network maintenance (configuration changes, firmware upgrades, etc) Leading and participating in network lifecycle activities, cloud connectivity design and testing Design and implement new, effective solutions to improve security and effectiveness of our network infrastructure on-prem and in cloud (AWS) Participate in Network Security / Firewall related projects / activities, collaborate closely with colleagues to make meaningful outcome together What We're Looking For Proven experience in network security engineering within enterprise environments. Experience with load balancing solutions, including Citrix NetScaler/ADC and other load-balancing technologies. Understanding of routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, DMVPN, NHRP), networking concepts, and best practices. Experience with Cisco security technologies, including FMC, FTD, ASA, Cisco ISE, TACACS+, and other AAA solutions. Experience in using troubleshooting tools (Wireshark, for example). Knowledge of cloud networking, mainly AWS, including AWS VPC networking. Good troubleshooting skills. Good English communication skills (B2 or higher). Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Experience with Fortinet and Palo Alto next-generation firewalls is nice to have. Understanding of Zero Trust networking and SASE platforms, including Zscaler, is nice to have. Exposure to cloud migration or automation projects, including Terraform, is nice to have. Knowledge of SDN or network automation tools is nice to have. Exposure to Nutanix, VMware networking, and enterprise wireless networking is nice to have. What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package along with wellness resources and work-life balance support in line with your country practices and Avon purpose aiming to help you live a healthier life, protect you and your dear ones, and ensure you’re at your best. At Avon, we believe beauty is for everyone and that it’s beautiful to be you. We celebrate our differences, champion self-expression and are committed to inclusion for all. We embrace diversity and individuality to build a culture that represents our communities and enables everyone to bring their best self to work. We also support reasonable adjustments both within our recruitment process and job design when required to empower you to work in a way that works for you. Ready to be a part of it?
